title: Depression in England: new diagnoses flat, the register grows
context: England's depression register has more than doubled, but new diagnoses each year have barely moved since 2018/19: the register grows because people stay on it.
ask: How many people on the register are still depressed today, and how many were never taken off?

series.label: Depression register
series.about: Adults on GP depression registers: diagnosed since April 2006 and not marked resolved. It grows whenever more people are added than taken off.

series.label: New depression diagnoses
series.about: Adults newly diagnosed with depression in the year, as a share of adult patients: the measure of how many new cases doctors are recording.

series.label: Psychosis register
series.about: Patients of all ages on the register for schizophrenia, bipolar disorder and other psychoses, or treated with lithium.

numbers.text: newly diagnosed each year; peak 1.7% in 2018/19.
on the psychosis register (schizophrenia, bipolar, other psychoses).

caveats: No depression register figure was published for 2023/24.
